name: A Righteous Cause
label: Quest
description: A Righteous Cause witnesses a conversation between Leonid Barthalomew the Revered and Danitha Morr as they reflect on the defense of the Undercity…
intro: A Righteous Cause witnesses a conversation between Leonid Barthalomew the Revered and Danitha Morr as they reflect on the defense of the Undercity against Naxxramas. Their exchange highlights the memory of Garek Bandarion, an undead hero who rediscovered how to wield the Holy Light as a paladin. The quest illuminates the rare Forsaken who strive to maintain their connection to the Light despite the skepticism of their kin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.
He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.
If only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...

clips.title: Completion
paras: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.
